title: LLM4Cell: A Survey of Large Language and Agentic Models for Single-Cell Biology

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating single-cell foundation and agentic models on an 'Atlas fairness' dimension by reviewing published evidence to see if models address dataset imbalances or enforce demographic parity regarding the human donors in their training atlases.

Assessing the representation balance of training corpora and model evaluations to identify over-representation of specific tissues (e.g., immune cells) and species (e.g., human and mouse) compared to underrepresented rare-cell, plant, and microbial systems.
